_comment: Antigen QA hard-mode MCP config. PREFERRED: point antigen-browser at scripts/run-antigen-browser-adapter-qa.sh (single source of QA env). The adapter fails closed (FATAL) if launched without the QA flags unless ANTIGEN_ADAPTER_REQUIRE_QA_ENV=false. Replace <ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO_REPO> and <delegation-token>. See docs/dev/antigen-qa-mcp.md. DO NOT also register a raw `playwright` server pointing at @playwright/mcp, and do NOT pre-allowlist mcp__playwright__* tools during Antigen QA — that lets the agent bypass the Antigen adapter and attach raw Playwright to the same Chrome.
_comment_direct_fallback: If you must invoke node directly instead of the wrapper, use { "command": "node", "args": ["<ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO_REPO>/examples/antigen-browser-adapter.mjs"], "env": { ...all QA flags... } }. The fail-closed guard requires AEGIS_API_BASE, AEGIS_AGENT_TOKEN, ANTIGEN_BROWSER_TRACE=true, ANTIGEN_BROWSER_REQUIRE_ANTIGEN_TOOLS=true, ANTIGEN_BROWSER_REQUIRE_REALISTIC_NAVIGATION=true, ANTIGEN_INPUT_REALISM=realistic (and warns unless ANTIGEN_BROWSER_HEADLESS=false). The wrapper form is safer because it cannot be launched with a partial env.
